claims.claim_text: Architected a governed, policy-gated agent execution surface for enterprise AI workflows, defining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths for regulated deployments.
Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing partner deal support with usage-based subscription forecasting to expand recurring revenue.
Established audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through context engineering and runtime resilience controls governing evaluation gates and rollback.

Standardized the production adoption lifecycle for client AI systems, compressing the lab-to-production cycle from six months to three weeks through replayable runtime design and exit disposition governance.
Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse and cloud data pipelines with dense sparse exact retrieval design.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability, applying an operating model for agentic AI to convert bespoke delivery into productized IP.
